WPMS No. 3562 of 2024
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Siddhartha Singh, Advocate for 
the petitioner.
2. Mr. Arvind Kumar Sharma, Advocate 
for the respondent.
3. Learned counsel for respondent 
prays for and is granted four weeks’ time 
to file counter affidavit.
4. List on 12.03.2025.
5. In the meantime, subject to 
petitioner depositing a sum of ₹12,000/-
per month as use & occupation charges 
of the premises in question before the 
learned trial Court w.e.f. 01.01.2025, on 
or before 7th day of each succeeding 
month, petitioner shall not be 
dispossessed from the premises in 
question. In case of any default, 
petitioner shall be evicted forthwith and 
the respondent shall be at liberty to 
initiate execution proceedings.
6. Stay Application (I.A. No. 1 of 2024) 
stands disposed of. 
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 30.12.2024
Navin
